title: Lightly Crunchy Mexican Chicken Tacos
description: A kid-friendly Mexican dish featuring jerk seasoned chicken, served in a taco with crunchy toppings, made with halal-friendly ingredients and a hint of dashi extract for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the chicken pieces, jerk seasoning, and dashi extract until the chicken is well coated.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and cook the chicken until browned and cooked through.
Warm the taco shells in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the tacos by placing the cooked chicken into the taco shells and topping with shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, and shredded cheese.
Drizzle the tops of the tacos with sour cream.
Serve the tacos immediately and enjoy.
